task_description: Write a method in Dafny to perform index wise addition of sequence elements in the given two nested sequences.
specification_response:
method IndexWiseAddSequences(seq1: seq<seq<int>>, seq2: seq<seq<int>>) returns (result: seq<seq<int>>)
Postconditions_prompt:
- The result sequence has the same length as the input sequences
- For each index i in the range of the sequence length, the resulting sequence at position i is a sequence where each element is the sum of the corresponding elements from seq1[i] and seq2[i]
- The length of each inner sequence in the result matches the length of the corresponding inner sequences in the input sequences at the same position

Step 1: Determine the method’s signature.
In this case:
    method IndexWiseAdd(seq1: seq<seq<int>>, seq2: seq<seq<int>>) returns (result: seq<seq<int>>)
    
Step 2: Determine the preconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - Both input sequences are not null
    - Both sequences have the same length
    - Corresponding inner sequences have the same length

Step 4: Write the code, its formal specification, and the verification annotations that help the solver prove the postconditions.
In this case:

```dafny
method IndexWiseAdd(seq1: seq<seq<int>>, seq2: seq<seq<int>>) returns (result: seq<seq<int>>)
    requires seq1 != null && seq2 != null
    requires |seq1| == |seq2|
    requires forall i :: 0 <= i < |seq1| ==> |seq1[i]| == |seq2[i]|
    ensures |result| == |seq1|
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |seq1| ==> |result[i]| == |seq1[i] + seq2[i]|
{
    var resSeq := new seq<int>[|seq1|];
    i := 0;
    while i < |seq1|
        invariant 0 <= i <= |seq1|
        invariant |resSeq| == i
        invariant forall j :: 0 <= j < i ==> |resSeq[j]| == |seq1[j] + seq2[j]|
    {
        var innerRes := new int[|seq1[i]|];
        var j := 0;
        while j < |seq1[i]|
            invariant 0 <= j <= |seq1[i]|
            invariant |innerRes| == j
            invariant forall k :: 0 <= k < j ==> innerRes[k] == seq1[i][k] + seq2[i][k]
        {
            innerRes[j] := seq1[i][j] + seq2[i][j];
            j := j + 1;
        }
        resSeq[i] := innerRes;
        i := i + 1;
    }
    result := resSeq;
}
```
